items.text: Emma Sharif is the mayor of Compton, a position she has held since July 2021. She previously served on the city council from 2015. She previously served as a trustee on the Compton Unified School District board. She holds a master’s degree in public administration.

sentences.text: Emma Sharif is the mayor of Compton, a position she has held since July 2021.
She previously served on the city council from 2015.
She previously served as a trustee on the Compton Unified School District board.
She holds a master’s degree in public administration.

items.text: During her 2021 campaign, she said she wanted to hold the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department accountable for deputy shootings and tackle homelessness. Also in her 2021 campaign, she pledged to finish street repairs, recruit businesses, and increase senior programs. Her current campaign lists priorities including public safety, business support, infrastructure, youth programs, and housing stability.

items.text: Her official profile says that under her leadership, the city launched a $19.5 million infrastructure improvement program. The program included $4 million in road maintenance and over 100 crosswalk upgrades. It also included a $1.2 million tree maintenance contract. Her campaign says she secured over $40 million for school repairs through an Emergency Repair Program.
